subject.title: feat: Add Anthropic server-side compaction API support

question: Should Anthropic-native compaction be exposed through typed Anthropic model/run parameters, or as a cross-provider `agents.defaults.compaction` mode with defined pause and fallback behavior?
rationale: Current source and upstream contracts establish the missing implementation, but they do not determine the public configuration owner or how provider `compaction` termination interacts with local compaction and the agent loop.

options.title: Provider run parameters
options.body: Add typed Anthropic threshold, pause, and instruction parameters with complete request, streaming, history, usage, tests, docs, and live proof in the provider boundary.

options.title: Cross-provider compaction mode
options.body: Add an Anthropic mode under agent compaction config and explicitly define provider switching, non-Anthropic fallback, and local-compaction interaction.

options.title: Broader passthrough first
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/54041 to define the common Anthropic context-management API before implementing this focused capability.

recommendation.title: Provider run parameters
recommendation.body: Add typed Anthropic threshold, pause, and instruction parameters with complete request, streaming, history, usage, tests, docs, and live proof in the provider boundary.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest combination of recent Anthropic transport/config history and prior item-specific product review context.
